limitations: ANATOMICAL leg only: wiring geometry, NOT an operating point (L164).
Operator powers are walks WITH revisits, not paths; pool cells are themselves reachable so deeper arrivals include recurrent mass.
r_d = A^d 1 is source-FREE (summed over all sources) — it is the depth-d generalisation of in-mass, not a per-actor reach.
A_inf is read off the RIGHT Perron vector only; it is exact in the limit, so any disagreement with A_cell(8) is pre-asymptotic residue, not an error in A_inf.
lam2 by real Hotelling deflation cannot represent a COMPLEX subdominant pair: non-convergence is reported with its range and routes the card to R_DEGENERATE, never to a number.
The d=1..3 successive-difference ratios were derivable from l209/static.json before this card ran and are DESCRIPTION, not evidence (Kriegeskorte 2009; the PREREG states them in full).
The Crofts leg is a different OPERATOR (per-edge reweighting), not a normalisation of the same one, and is scored as its own leg.
No neuromere column exists on BANC, so no legblock tier is possible.
